I implemented all six functions in `minidb/expr_eval.py`. `pytest tests/test_expr_eval.py` gives 25 passed. I didn't run the rest of the test suite, and I didn't change `tests/test_expr_eval.py`.

`compare` raises `ValueError` for an operator outside the six comparison operators; the spec didn't cover that case.

I also added a private helper, `_check_bool`, which the `NOT`/`AND`/`OR` functions and `where_matches` use to reject non-boolean, non-NULL values.
